mode: read-only static source plus decoded PNG pixels; no engine, rendering, capture or performance run
scope: 71 formal World actors: 40 enemy kinds + 6 bosses + 25 named NPCs. GeneratedMain and old catalogs are separate inventory, not completion.

count_semantics.png_files: Physical PNG sources, not pose count; atlas stores many regions
count_semantics.visible_pose_pixels: Decoded crop, transparent border removed, alpha-zero RGB normalized; dimensions included in SHA256
count_semantics.normal_selector_upper_bound: Static normal state reachability, not proof of displayed frames; interrupt/timing/residency can reduce it
count_semantics.stationary_exception: Knockback home-return code can request walk before stationary placement reset; four walk crops remain conditional, not normal roaming footage.

animation_counts_note: Within-animation unique counts come from decoded crop/visible-pose hashes in full evidence. Manifest hashes plus PNG hashes and per-frame tuples preserve source identity. Different pixels do not prove coherent keyframes.

original_asset_override.description: Original creature manifest overrides configured sprite/parts when present; current 46 kinds all resolve here.

enemy_phase_speed_scaling.description: Windup and active speed_scale=N/(manifest_fps*phase_seconds); recover immediately selects idle. Nominal source-pose hold is duration/N, not fixed manifest FPS.

direct_cross_action.description: No transition clip/blend selected for idle/walk/windup/active/hurt/death. Timing interruptions can reduce displayed-frame count.

single_pose_hurt_death.description: One hurt/death source pose. Ordinary hurt recovery 0.16s; boss hurt may be overwritten. Death adds 0.05s then 0.45s enemy/0.9s boss fade, downward motion and scaling; procedural effects are not source frames.

no_original_direction_clips.description: Current original manifests have no left/right clips; flip_h changes facing without adding source drawings.

same_name_not_restarted.description: play is called only when animation name changes; repeated hurt/phase can retain the same timeline/completed frame. Static risk, not measured failure.

stationary_walk_conditional.description: Stationary patrol/combat use idle and reset position. Walk inventory is not a normal roaming requirement; knockback/home-return code can conditionally request it before reset, untested.

clock_walk_not_distance.description: Four walk poses at 9fps, not displacement-driven. Flyers use walk-named wing/body poses plus procedural vertical motion.

boss_phase_reuse.description: HP threshold selects phase during 0.9s pause, not phase_windup; same body clip is also used by phase-gated skills.

ordinary_two_commands_share_attack.description: Two distinct ordinary commands share windup2/attack2. Dive, vault, combo, lunge, retreat, feint, blink and projectiles add procedural behavior, not body drawings.

npc_two_state_selector.description: Create idle; talk for dialogue/route/wish/quest delivery; close returns idle. Idle2 at 2.5fps and talk2 at 4fps.

npc_no_walk.description: No walk/roam state; narrative movement updates or reconstructs position. Do not invent missing gameplay.

npc_greet_rest_inventory_only.description: Greet1/rest1 source poses exist but have no current call; do not count them as displayed interaction states.

G00_CONFIRMED_CROP_FRAGMENT.description: 目检确认跨格截断/邻格残片。先补全完整角色源帧，后做关键帧增加。

G00_CROP_EDGE_REVIEW_CANDIDATE.description: alpha>128跨裁区边界候选，尚非人工确认缺陷。

G01_RECOVERY_TO_IDLE.description: 收招状态直接选idle，无专用recover身体帧。

G02_ONE_POSE_REACTION_DEATH.description: hurt与death各一姿态；白闪/击退/溶解不是新身体帧。

G03_CROSS_ACTION_NO_BRIDGE.description: idle/walk/前摇/有效/受击/死亡之间直接切动画；方向翻转；无独立桥帧选择。

G04_TWO_COMMANDS_ONE_ATTACK.description: 两种不同普通怪招式共用windup2/attack2；按语义差异判断是否拆分。

G05_FOUR_POSE_CLOCK_WALK.description: walk四姿态9fps按时间播放；位移速度可变，步态/脚底需后续实录检查。

G06_FLIGHT_ATTACK_BODY_MISMATCH_RISK.description: 飞行用walk命名源帧与程序悬浮；巡航/俯冲/施法及回程的身体连续待检。

G07_IDLE_CAST_PRIORITY_NOT_WALK.description: 驻守角色正常idle而非行走；优先待机、施法和收势，不补不存在的漫游状态。

G08_BOSS_TWO_POSE_PHASES.description: Boss各攻击阶段仅两身体姿态；phase还被HP相变共用，同名请求不一定重播。

N01_TWO_POSE_IDLE_TALK.description: idle2/talk2确为不同源姿态，仍需低频循环动态复核，不能视作已顺畅。

N02_IDLE_TALK_NO_TRANSITION.description: 对话直接idle↔talk，无抬手/收手过渡选择；greet/rest未用，无行走玩法。

N03_SHARED_GENERATED_IDENTITY.description: GeneratedMain按章节共享六套原创NPC，不是36套独立角色。

non_world_inventory.generated_npc_note: 36 IDs share six chapter-fallback art sets; no extra unique body art; not default World scene.

old_bestiary.reason: All current species prefer original_creatures manifests.

non_world_inventory.note: Do not credit old catalogs, aliases, generated shared identities or uncalled animations as newly completed motion.

manual_static_inspection_scope: Five priority contact sheets (ground6, flight6, boss base6, boss skills6, NPC6) plus sunken_hammer_smith attacks.png source. Not a visual pass for every remaining frame.

repair_feasibility.scope: Two read-only source examples only; no crop editing, runtime edits or new art.
repair_feasibility.coordinate_convention: Region x,y,w,h; bounding boxes x0,y0,x1,y1 with exclusive right/bottom. Four-connected alpha>128 components.
repair_feasibility.conclusion: Weapon pixels survive across allocated grid boundaries. Bounding rectangles overlap, so region/margin alone cannot isolate full poses. Separate-pose masks may salvage existing pixels; redraw only after actual occlusion, missing pixels or source-edge truncation is established.
repair_feasibility.first_batch_recommendation: gear_sentinel attack[0]/attack[1], independent candidate assets preserving antialiased edge pixels and weapon/foot registration. No blanket alpha-threshold clipping.
repair_feasibility.integration_owner: Single integration owner handles product integration and live capture; audit worker remains read-only.
